notes.title: Aseprite update for Steam on macOS Ventura
notes.notes:
Due a new issue with macOS Ventura, we've made some changes to Aseprite packages on Steam.

If you see the following popup when you try to run Aseprite on macOS, it's highly probably that you've updated your system to macOS 13.0 Ventura. Just press "Move to Trash" button:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/e5e85dcfbf96de4e57e0d9d6c48fd19416a877f0.png

Then re-start Steam, and press the Launch button on Aseprite, you might see an error like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/333e9912d8fd5e1a1fdafc17121e57d6cff77d11.png

But in a second try launching Aseprite, Steam will re-install Aseprite:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/b1376110b4120345294133a7dd91d031c07ee208.png

That should be enough.

[hr][/hr]

In any case, if you have Aseprite installed and the problem still persists, you can right-click Aseprite and select Manage > Browse local files and delete the Aseprite folder:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11891144/f1b7f7e3625541fabcb8cf8d75b111af33b218be.png

Then re-start Steam, and re-install Aseprite. Restarting Steam is important because that leads to re-downloading some metadata about the new version that is available on Steam.

[hr][/hr]

For more details: https://community.aseprite.org/t/aseprite-update-for-steam-on-macos-ventura/16229

notes.title: Aseprite v1.1.10 and v1.2-beta4 update
notes.notes:
Hi asepriters! Today we are releasing v1.1.10 and v1.2-beta4 with new features and several fixes.

Aseprite v1.1.10:

Support symmetry at the center of one pixel
Added keyboard shortcuts to change the layer opacity with Shift+1, Shift+2, Shift+3, and Shift+4.
Added option to use Rectangular Marquee and Lasso tools with right click
Added default grid options in preferences dialog
Added option to play all frames ignoring tags
Added option to disable auto-scroll
Added a tick mark next to the preset palette that matches the active one
Added visual indicator when Aseprite is saving data to recover files from a crash
Added an option to change the initial frame number on the Timeline
Improved the dialog to open a sequence of files (frame1.png, frame2.png, etc.)
macOS: Smooth scroll with trackpad on list boxes and other widgets
Detect the file format by its content instead of this extension when possible
Esc key closes Layer/Cel properties dialog
Tab key cycle through RGB/HSV color text fields
Show all tools/quicktools on keyboard shortcuts preferences
Fixed crashing when the user-defined theme doesn't exist anymore
Fixed bug which we can get stuck moving a cel
Fixed crash using "Play Once" option
Fixed several bugs & issues

Aseprite v1.2-beta4:

New option to add reference layers, useful for rotoscoping
Initial support for Timeline thumbnails
Added new --oneframe CLI parameter to load just one frame
Fixed loading layer groups from .ase files with complex hierarchies/multiple levels
Fixed all commands related to the entire canvas (resize sprite, rotate sprite, flip sprite, etc.) when the sprite contains collapsed groups
+All changes in v1.1.10

More information in Aseprite blog announcement.

notes.title: Aseprite v1.1.6 update
notes.notes:
New Aseprite v1.1.6 is available with bug fixes and some minor improvements!


Right-click can move layers/frames/cels in the timeline
Added right-click with Ctrl+click on OS X in some controls (timeline, tabs, text entries)
Fixed bug ignoring Space bar on Sprite Editor when it’s used immediately after clicking in the Timeline
Ask for saving each file on exit
Right-click subtracts a selection area when we use it inside the sprite editor selection
Added option to include partial tiles in Import Sprite Sheet
Configuration is saved in ~/Library/Application Support/Aseprite on OS X now
Added forward compatibility for .ase files with groups
Added support to load Pixly (.anim) files
Expand filename wildcards in command line on Windows
Fixed issues with some convolution matrices after inserting text
Fixed OS X keyboard modifiers when we switch apps using ⌘Tab (⌘ isn’t kept pressed)


More information in Aseprite blog announcement.

notes.title: Aseprite v1.1.5 update
notes.notes:
New Aseprite version is available with a lot of bug fixes and a couple of new minor features:

New option for paint bucket to use all layers as reference
Added copy & paste support of images on OS X
Added Wacom eraser support on Windows and OS X
Improved status bar
Don't destroy custom brush when we use X key to switch colors
Improve selection rectangle/shape feedback with a negative black/white color, so it's always visible
Fixed blurry graphics when Windows DPI scaling is greater than 100%
Fixed bug copying frames between sprites: now frame duration is preserved
Fixed regression bug with default folder for new files
Use correct/configured Eraser brush size when Eraser is activated with right-click or as a quicktool (bug report on Steam)
Fixed brush size when we click on brush icon
Fixed crash pressing º key on keyboard configuration
Fixed crash when we press Del or Backspace keys while we are moving a cel

More information in Aseprite blog announcement.

notes.title: Aseprite v1.1.4 update
notes.notes:
New Aseprite version released with several bug fixes and some new features:
New backend on Windows and OS X. Improved trackpad support on OS X. This is the first step to improve the UX with wacom tablets, pressure, multiple-windows, etc. (issue 139)Now we can scale from center/pivot (issue 576) and flipping (issue 579)You can select a tile by double clicking over it (issue 939)Add View > Extras menu to hide the selection edges (issue 861)Mouse wheel rotate hue value when used above color selectors (issue 1012)New keyboard customization for tool modifiers (issue 1028)Fixed regression using --bach and --save-as with .png and other formats (issue 1018)Fixed several issues (issue 905, issue 914)

More information: http://blog.aseprite.org/post/142691906055/aseprite-v114

notes.title: Aseprite v1.1.3 update
notes.notes:
A new update has been released with several bug fixes and a couple of new features:
Added new color picker to quickly select different tints, shades, and tones of the current colorNow clicking foreground/background color will change the colors in a custom brush created with Edit > New BrushFixed crash creating a custom brush without "Type" parameter and restarting the applicationFixed bug resetting Screen Scaling valueFixed several bugs with grayscale imagesFixed a crash using Windows clipboard in special casesFixed Wacom tablet lag on Windows platformAdded more zoom levels
